Docker Content Trust is replaced by Sigstore Cosign: every image is signed keylessly in CD and verified against this repository's workflow identity before promotion and rollback.
ACR quarantine is replaced by the CD gate: Trivy scans each image before it is signed, and only signed digests deploy.
Single-region service (South Africa North, zone-redundant registry); images are rebuildable from git.

Storage uses Microsoft-managed keys with infrastructure (double) encryption. Customer-managed keys add a Key Vault key lifecycle with no requirement for it yet; revisit if a data-protection assessment requires CMK.
Queue-service logging: neither storage account uses queues. Blob audit logs go to Log Analytics through diagnostic settings.
False positive: blob logging is configured on the account's blobServices/default diagnostic setting (audit category group), which this check does not link to the container.
False positive: the name is built from a subscription hash (stcpitfstate + 6 hex), which the check cannot evaluate; it is valid.
Key Vault public endpoint denies all traffic except the deploying runner during a run (scripts/vault-firewall.sh); apps use the private endpoint. Closes with self-hosted runners.
Connection-string secrets have no expiry date because an expiry would stop the app, not rotate it; rotation is database_password_version (write-only, never in state).
False positive: PostgreSQL uses VNet integration (delegated subnet, private DNS, public access disabled), which is private without a private endpoint.
Rollback takes the environment and optional image digests as inputs by design. It builds nothing, and scripts/release.sh refuses any image without a Cosign signature from deploy.yml on main.
